bagPolicy.summary: Small bags and handbags up to 35 × 40 × 19 cm are permitted after search; backpacks and larger bags are barred. No cloakroom or bag storage is available.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena has no dedicated public parking; Q-Park offers event discounts at several nearby city-centre garages.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena’s current travel and security pages do not designate a rideshare pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions and hospitality are available inside. Outside food and drinks are prohibited; request advance approval for medically necessary drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The arena publishes an accessible travel and seating guide; Woodhouse Lane car park has 14 Blue Badge spaces, with listed evening event parking at £7.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No readmission is allowed after leaving the arena; designated smoking areas are upstairs on either side of the concourse.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
